summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. published an extraordinary general meeting notice on Form 6-K to resolve on the merger of Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the company. The EGM is scheduled for June 30, 2026, to ratify the hiring of PricewaterhouseCoopers for an appraisal report, approve the report and the merger protocol dated May 28, 2026. No financial terms, share price, premium, or deal value are disclosed. The merger follows Brazilian corporate law (Law 6.404/76). The filing provides participation instructions including in-person attendance and remote voting. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice for an internal reorganization, not a transformative special situation.
